name: Bad Counsel
overview: Scripture warns against following bad counsel, emphasizing that ungodly advice leads away from righteousness and invites God's displeasure, as seen in the rebuke of Eliphaz and his friends for misrepresenting God (Job 42:7). The Psalms highlight the blessing of avoiding the counsel of the wicked, while Proverbs contrasts the deceitful plans of the wicked with the wisdom gained from heeding good advice. Wisdom comes from walking with the wise and accepting correction, whereas foolishness results from trusting one's own misguided judgment or associating with fools, which ultimately leads to ruin.
